text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Alright, that's it for today's routine...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Training with Narita Taishin has been progressing smoothly.
I can tell she feels the results herself. However—

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
—Great work again today!
You're coming along nicely for the next race!

text_block_list.name: Friendly Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Really?! Ehehehe, guess I can look forward
to a nice reward after the race then~, just saying♪

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's what you want?! All right then, I gotta make sure
to book that special premium dessert course from you-know-where!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching the dynamic between other Trainers and their horsegirls
sometimes gives me pause for thought.
choice_data_list: (Should I try to get to know Taishin better...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The only time I see her is during training sessions.
Because of that, I know next to nothing about her private life.
choice_data_list: Taishin, do you have a second?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...What?
I finished today's workout already. You still want something?
choice_data_list: Is there anywhere you'd like to go sometime?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Not really. I don't have time to fool around with you.
Anyway, I'm cooling down and calling it a day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...And off she went.
Maybe an opportunity to learn more will present itself as our bond deepens, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then one day, a letter arrived addressed "To All Academy Staff."
Enclosed was an aquarium ticket given as a token of appreciation from the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I thought about taking Narita Taishin along, but she'd just turned down my invitation.
With no other choice, I decided to go alone on my day off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A small aquarium situated out on the city outskirts. Quiet, with barely anyone around.
As a sparse trickle of people passed by now and then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I suddenly spotted a very familiar figure.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I thought about calling out to her, but—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Guess I'll move along.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was completely different from her usual self. Seeing her like that made me hesitate,
and before I knew it, I was simply watching her walk away in silence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Then again, it was a pretty small aquarium.
As I kept strolling, I ended up spotting her again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sign read "Exciting Touch Pool."
Apparently, you could dip your hands in the tank to interact directly with doctor fish.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...All right.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After cautiously making sure nobody was around,
she steeled her nerves and plunged her hands into the tank...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The result of her daring attempt—
Judging by her reaction, it tickled like crazy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, dusk began to settle in...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The crowd thinned out even further, leaving the place almost entirely empty.
The interior had fallen dead silent, like the depths of the ocean floor.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Right in the middle of it all, all on her own,
she was happily snapping photos of a school of fish.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A girl who hates crowds, smiling at a school of fish.
Given how she usually acts, it was an incredibly rare sight—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —Ack! What are you doing here...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: By the time I realized it was too late to look away, I had to awkwardly scramble to greet her.
choice_data_list: U-Um, yeah, small world, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Would she snap at me, asking if I'd been quietly watching her?
Bracing myself, I timidly searched her face—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...This place is always like this, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: All I saw was a gentle, relaxed smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was this endless expanse of tranquil blue that put her at ease.
...Narita Taishin quietly continued.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
There's that much bigger, flashy aquarium pretty close by, right?
Big tour groups and crowds usually just flock over there instead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
So it's pretty much always quiet here. Lots of solo visitors, too.
Even when there are people, they're just fish geeks glued to the tanks, so—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Not a single soul gives a damn about me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The quiet building. The understated background music. The familiar girl before me—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Yet the expression she wore was one I had never seen before.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Though, the fish—who knows?
I wonder if these guys even realize I'm here... Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Well, either way's fine by me.
It feels like they're just "existing."

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I don't really mind... It's easier for me that way, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What are you smiling at?
choice_data_list: Nothing... Just happy to see you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whatever... Weirdo.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I'm heading out.
...This place closes pretty early, so keep an eye on the time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And with that, I quietly watched her walk away.
choice_data_list: (Today turned out to be a pretty nice day.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That thought gently crossed my mind...

text_block_list.name: Friendly Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
—Yesss, new personal best! Trainer, don't you think
you oughta go ahead and book that deluxe dessert set right now~?!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Hold your horses! A new record is amazing and all,
but sweets are a reward for winning an actual race...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing other Trainers and horsegirls sharing laughs looks fun, sure.
However—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: —*Pant*, *pant*, *pant*... Whew.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Skip the pep talk, what's next?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Why are you so pointlessly energetic today?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The way things are between Narita Taishin and me is just fine.
I had finally come to believe that with all my heart.
